crossRefs.note: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…

He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who…
As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him, before he goes up to the high place to eat; for…

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered…
I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather…
But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

parallels.note: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

translations.web: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
translations.bsb: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
translations.kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
translations.asv: and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the marriage feast: and they would not come.
